subject.title: fix(agents): bound image tool maxBytesMb and maxImages model parameters

question: Should the image agent tool adopt 100 MB and 100 images as its permanent model-input ceilings, including schema-level rejection for values above those limits?
rationale: These new maxima alter an existing model-tool contract and the diff does not derive the values from an established image-pipeline limit or prior maintainer decision.

options.title: Confirm the 100/100 contract
options.body: Accept the proposed ceilings after real behavior proof shows over-limit model calls remain safely and clearly handled.

options.title: Use pipeline-derived limits
options.body: Replace the arbitrary-looking ceilings with documented limits derived from downstream image-processing capacity and update the tool contract and tests.

options.title: Keep schema permissive
options.body: Retain only a runtime clamp if compatibility requires tool calls above the chosen ceiling to be coerced rather than schema-rejected.

recommendation.title: Confirm the 100/100 contract
recommendation.body: Accept the proposed ceilings after real behavior proof shows over-limit model calls remain safely and clearly handled.

likelyOwner.reason: This is a cross-cutting agent resource-boundary and compatibility choice rather than a mechanical test repair.
